sn55.12:1.2: Brāhmanā bhikkhave udayagāminiṃ nāma paṭipadam paññāpenti ||
sn55.12:1.4: Ehi tvam ambho purisa kālasseva uṭṭhāya pācīnamukho yāhi ||
sn55.12:1.5: so tvam mā semhaṃ parivajjehi || mā papātaṃ || mā khāṇum || mā kaṇṭakaṃ ṭhānam || mā candanikaṃ || mā oḷigallaṃ ||
sn55.12:1.7: Evaṃ tvam ambho purisa kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā sugatim saggam lokam upapajjissasīti || || 4.
sn55.12:2.1: Taṃ kho panetam bhikkhave brāhmaṇānaṃ bālagamanam etam mūḷhagamanam etam na nibbidāya na virāgāya na nirodhāya na upasamāya na abhiññāya na sambodhāya na nibbānāya saṃvattati || ||
sn55.12:2.2: Ahañ ca kho bhikkhave ariyassa vinaye udayagāminim paṭipadam paññāpemi ||
sn55.12:2.3: yā ekantanibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya upasamāya abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattati || ||
sn55.12:3.1: Katamā ca yā bhikkhave udayagāminī paṭipadā ||
sn55.12:3.3: Idha bhikkhave ariyasāvako Buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti ||
sn55.12:3.4: Iti pi so Bhagavā || pe-la || satthā devamanussānam buddho bhagavā ti ||
sn55.12:3.7: Ariyakantehi sīlehi samannāgato hoti akhaṇḍehi || la-pe || samādhisaṃvattanikehi || || 6.
sn55.12:3.8: Ayaṃ kho sā bhikkhave udayagāminī patipadā yā ekantanibbidāya || la ||
